title: Landa Amavidiyo nama-Reels e-Instagram Efonini naku-Laptop
description: Landa amavidiyo nama-Reels e-Instagram efonini noma ku-laptop ngaphandle kwe-app nokungena. Kopisha ilinki, uyinamathisele ku-I Need Save, ukhethe.
photo2Caption: Namathisela ilinki ye-Reels ku-I Need Save.
body:
Wake wathola i-Reels ehlekisayo, isifundo sokupheka, noma ividiyo ekhuthazayo ofuna ukuyibuka futhi kamuva ngaphandle kokuyifuna kabusha? Izindaba ezinhle wukuthi ungalanda amavidiyo nama-Reels e-Instagram ngqo ku-browser usebenzisa i-I Need Save. Akudingeki ufake i-app, akudingeki ungene ngemvume, futhi kulula ngokufanayo efonini naku-laptop.

Ake sibheke izinyathelo, izinketho zamafayela ezikhona, nezinto ezimbalwa okufanele uzazi ngaphambi kokuqala.

Yikuphi Okuqukethwe kwe-Instagram Okungalandwa?

I-I Need Save isebenza nokuthunyelwe okusesidlangalaleni ku-Instagram. Lokhu kusho ukuthi amavidiyo noma ama-Reels avela kuma-akhawunti angakhiyiwe uvamise ukukwazi ukuwalondoloza. Ngaphandle kwevidiyo, ungathatha nesithombe noma isithonjana salokho okuthunyelwe.

Kukhona into eyodwa okufanele uyazi kusukela ekuqaleni: i-Instagram kwesinye isikhathi ivimba izicelo noma idinga ukungena ngemvume. Uma lokho kwenzeka, ukulanda kungehluleka noma ngabe okuthunyelwe kusesidlangalaleni. Ngokuvamile udinga nje ukuzama futhi emva kwesikhashana.

Indlela Yokulanda ama-Reels e-Instagram Efonini

Lezi zinyathelo zisebenza ku-Android naku-iPhone.

  1. Vula i-app ye-Instagram bese udlala i-Reels noma ividiyo ofuna ukuyilondoloza.
  2. Thepha inkinobho ethi Yabelana (Share) kulokho okuthunyelwe.
  3. Khetha Kopisha ilinki (Copy link).
  4. Vula i-browser bese uya ku-ineedsave.com.
  5. Namathisela ilinki ebhokisini elikhona, noma uthephe inkinobho ethi Namathisela ukuze kushesha.
  6. Cindezela okuthi Landa, bese ulinda kuvele uhlu lwezinketho.
  7. Khetha ikhwalithi yevidiyo oyifunayo, futhi ifayela lizoqala ukulanda.

Kwamanye amavidiyo, inkinobho ingabonisa okuthi Iyalungisa…. Lokho kusho ukuthi ividiyo iqala icutshungulwe, isibonelo ividiyo nomsindo wayo kuyahlanganiswa. Vele ulinde, ukulanda kuzoqala ngokuzenzakalelayo uma ifayela selilungile.

Indlela Yokulanda Amavidiyo e-Instagram ku-Laptop

Uma uvame ukuvula i-Instagram kukhompyutha, indlela nayo ilula:

  1. Vula i-Instagram ku-browser bese uchofoza okuthunyelwe kwevidiyo noma i-Reels oyifunayo.
  2. Kopisha ilinki yayo kumenyu ethi Yabelana noma ku-address bar ye-browser.
  3. Vula ithebhu entsha, vakashela ikhasi lokulanda le-I Need Save, bese unamathisela ilinki.
  4. Chofoza okuthi Landa bese ukhetha inketho oyidingayo.

Okulandiwe kuzolondolozwa kufolda ethi Downloads (Okulandiwe) kukhompyutha yakho.

Kungani i-Browser Ilula Kakhulu?

Ukulanda ngewebhusayithi kunezinzuzo ezimbalwa. Akudingeki ufake i-app edla indawo yokugcina, akudingeki unikeze imininingwane yokungena, futhi indlela iyafana kuwo wonke amadivayisi. Isayithi le-I Need Save litholakala ngezilimi ezingu-93 futhi lilandela ngokuzenzakalelayo itimu ekhanyayo noma emnyama yefoni yakho, ngakho kuhlala kumnandi ukulisebenzisa noma nini. Ngaphandle kwe-Instagram, ungasebenzisa le ndlela efanayo ku-TikTok, Facebook, X (Twitter), naku-Pinterest.

Izinketho Zamafayela Ezikhona

Ngemuva kokuthi ilinki icutshunguliwe, uzobona izinketho ezimbalwa. Inani nezinhlobo zazo kuncike kokuthunyelwe kwangempela:

  • Ividiyo ngamakhwalithi ahlukene, isibonelo 360p, 720p, noma 1080p.
  • Umsindo ngekhwalithi yangempela, noma i-MP3 ye-192 kbps eguqulwe evidiyweni. Kufanelekile uma udinga izwi noma umculo wangemuva kuphela.
  • Isithombe / Isithonjana sokuthunyelwe.

Ithiphu: Uma indawo yokugcina yefoni yakho isiqala ukugcwala, khetha i-720p. Isithombe sisacacile esikrinini sefoni, kodwa ifayela lincane kune-1080p.

Ukuthola Ividiyo Ngemuva Kokuyilanda

Uma ukulanda sekuqediwe, nansi indawo yefayela lakho:

  • I-Android: vula ifolda ethi Downloads (Okulandiwe) nge-app yokuphatha amafayela. I-app ye-Gallery kwesinye isikhathi idinga isikhashana ngaphambi kokuthi ividiyo ivele lapho.
  • I-iPhone/iPad (Safari): vula i-app ethi Files, bese ungena kufolda ethi Downloads (Okulandiwe). Ukuze udlulisele ividiyo ku-app ethi Photos, vula ividiyo ku-Files, thepha okuthi Share (Yabelana), bese ukhetha Save Video (Londoloza Ividiyo).

Uma usadidekile ukuthola ifayela, umhlahlandlela othi lapho amafayela alandiwe akhona ku-Android naku-iPhone ukuchaza ngokuningiliziwe.

Enye into ezokwenza ukhululeke: amafayela adluliswa ngqo esuka ku-Instagram aye kudivayisi yakho futhi awagcinwa kuseva ye-I Need Save.

Kungani Ividiyo Ye-Instagram Ingalandeki?

Uma inqubo yehluleka, hlola lezi zizathu ezingaba khona:

  • Okuthunyelwe kuvela ku-akhawunti eyimfihlo. Okuqukethwe okuyimfihlo akukwazi ukulandwa.
  • Okuqukethwe kubonakala kuphela ngemuva kokungena ngemvume, noma kukhawulelwe ezifundeni ezithile.
  • I-Instagram ivimba izicelo noma idinga ukungena ngemvume. Zama futhi emva kwesikhashana.
  • Ilinki enamathiselwe akuyona ilinki yokuthunyelwe, isibonelo ilinki yephrofayela. Yikopishe futhi enkinobhweni ethi Yabelana yokuthunyelwe.

Hlonipha Umsebenzi Wabadali

Sebenzisa amavidiyo owalandile ukuze kube ngokwakho kuphela. Uma ufuna ukuwaphinda uwathumele, qala ucele imvume kumdali futhi ubalule igama lakhe ngokucacile. Abadali basebenze kanzima ukwenza lokho okuqukethwe, ngakho amalungelo abo obunikazi kufanele ahlonishwe.

Imibuzo Evame Ukubuzwa

Ngidinga ukungena ku-Instagram ukuze ngilande?

Cha. Vele unamathisele ilinki yokuthunyelwe okusesidlangalaleni ku-I Need Save ngaphandle kokungena ngemvume.

Ngingawalanda yini ama-Reels avela ku-akhawunti eyimfihlo?

Cha. Okuqukethwe okuvela kuma-akhawunti ayimfihlo, okudinga ukungena ngemvume, nokukhawulelwe ngokwesifunda akukwazi ukulandwa. Kusekelwa okuthunyelwe okusesidlangalaleni kuphela.

Ngingalondoloza yini izithombe ezivela kokuthunyelwe ku-Instagram?

Yebo. Ngemuva kokucindezela okuthi Landa, khetha inketho ethi Isithombe / Isithonjana evela ohlwini lwezinketho.
